Spec: rewrite the welcome email for new trial users.
The welcome email goes out one minute after signup. It greets the person by first name, says in one
sentence what they can do in their first ten minutes, and gives exactly one button: create your first
project. No feature list, no discount, no social links. The subject line is short and plain. A second
email three days later goes only to people who have not created a project yet, and offers a
fifteen-minute call with a human instead of another tutorial.
